animations.name: grind

animations.behaviour: R: grind_enter in reverse time (hands release, sit up, rise to a half crouch, left foot then right foot forward)

deviations: Quern overall height is 0.121 m (brief ~0.11): grind_target stays at y=0.11 on the working-surface centre and the restrained saddle ends rise 12 mm above it.
Two extra quern anchors (handstone_rest, grain_patch_spot) were added for reproducible placement; the three required anchors are exact.

The handstone rests at the back of the stroke (handstone_rest, z=-0.11, 2.63 deg pitch) rather than exactly on grind_target, so that enter/exit hand over to the loop with zero velocity; grind_target is the stroke centre.
person_grinding.glb contains only the three new clips (the five r001 clips are not duplicated) and keeps the unchanged r001 carry_anchor node.
grind_exit is grind_enter played in reverse time.

Godot needs two import settings: grind loop_mode=LINEAR, and the AnimationPlayer optimizer disabled. With Godot's default optimizer the handstone path drifts by up to 3.4 mm (checks/godot_check_default_optimizer.json).
Scratch work used a folder next to the repository clone, not /tmp, because /tmp is blocked in this environment.

Transition revised after intake review: the one-knee lunge (raised left thigh through the tunic) was replaced by stepping both feet back in a half crouch and lowering both knees together; no thigh-through-tunic is visible in the GPU captures (visual judgement, skin weights unchanged).
